summary: Iteration 58 — E2E tested the new MyPath Lernvideos tab + previously-untested Community Feed, Admin Panel, Deep-Assist Modal, and Chat document upload. 11 pytest cases (8 pass, 3 fail due to spec/endpoint-name mismatches — actual implementation works correctly as wired in frontend). All 5 critical user flows work in the browser.

minor.issue: Spec says GET /api/community/posts for feed but code only exposes GET /api/community/feed. Frontend correctly calls /community/feed, so no functional impact. Rename spec OR add an alias.

Spec says /api/community/leaderboard but code only exposes /api/admin/community/leaderboard (public, gated only by login). Frontend already calls /admin/community/leaderboard correctly. No functional impact but naming/location is confusing.

Spec says multipart upload via /api/chat/sessions; actual implementation uses separate POST /api/chat/upload-document (single 'file' field). /chat/sessions only accepts JSON ChatSessionCreate body. Frontend ChatPage.js already uses /chat/upload-document correctly. No functional impact.
Spec body {topic, context}; implementation expects {situation, goal}. Frontend DeepAssistModal uses situation/goal. Just a spec mismatch.

frontend_test_results.mypath_lernvideos_accelerator: PASS — 10 cards, 0 UPGRADE badges, all unlocked

action_items: OPTIONAL: Align spec/docs with actual endpoint names — spec said /api/community/posts (GET) + /api/community/leaderboard + multipart /chat/sessions + {topic,context} body for deep-assist; actual implementation uses /community/feed, /admin/community/leaderboard, /chat/upload-document, and {situation,goal}. Frontend is already wired to the correct paths so no code change needed — just update the spec description next time.
OPTIONAL (nice-to-have): Consider adding a thin alias GET /api/community/posts -> feed and /api/community/leaderboard -> admin/community/leaderboard for API consistency.
critical_code_review_comments: services_tier.resolve_user_tier is called twice in my_path.py videos endpoint — OK performance.
Community feed is exposed at /feed but POST lives at /posts — inconsistent REST naming (minor).
Admin router hosts the PUBLIC community/leaderboard endpoint — should probably live in community.py for clarity.
test_credentials.md sample smoke-test script uses 'access_token' key, but login actually returns 'token'. Update credentials doc so new agents don't get confused.

success_rate.backend: 73% (8/11 — 3 failures are spec/naming mismatches, not functional bugs)

test_credentials: 5 pre-seeded accounts from /app/memory/test_credentials.md (password=test123). All login endpoints return {token, user} — NOT access_token.
seed_data_creation: Created 1 TEST_POST via POST /api/community/posts with starter user; deleted after verification.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 5 feature batches work end-to-end: (1) MyPath Lernvideos tab with correct tier gating (6 starter cards + 4 accelerator cards with CROWN/UPGRADE), (2) Community feed+post creation+leaderboard, (3) Deep-Assist modal with structured JSON output, (4) Chat document upload via /chat/upload-document, (5) Admin panel accessible & gated. Deep-Assist body is {situation, goal} NOT {topic, context}. Community feed is /community/feed NOT /community/posts. Leaderboard is /admin/community/leaderboard NOT /community/leaderboard. Chat doc upload is /chat/upload-document NOT multipart /chat/sessions. test_credentials.md smoke-test uses 'access_token' but API returns 'token' — known doc typo.
rca_of_the_issue: The 3 pytest failures are all due to the review-request description using different endpoint names/bodies than what the implementation actually uses. The frontend correctly calls the implemented endpoints, so all UI flows pass. Recommendation: update the review-request spec (or add route aliases) for consistency; no runtime bug exists.
